name: C algorithms and data structures library

mentions.name: C algorithms and data structures library
mentions.description: A C library consolidating assorted algorithms and data structures implemented over the years (lists, trees, stacks, queues, hash tables, memory pools), with APIs aligned and merged together, plus parsers for JSON, config file formats, and GPS/GNSS receiver data protocols, built around FSM-based components.
mentions.source_excerpt: Pulling together all of the assorted algorithms and data structures I implemented in C over the years out of necessity - lists, trees, stacks, queues, hash tables, memory pools, etc. - aligning the APIs, cleaning up and merging into a library. It's a background project but super fun. This and several parsers - JSON, some config file formats, and parsers for some GPS / GNSS receiver data protocols. FSMs also always feel like nice, clean fun.
